Overall verdict: needs_changes. FINDING (high, correctness): signoff/pre_merge guidance emits `dontpanic approve <plan> pre_merge` without validating that `pre_merge` is actually pending, so the exact command can exit 2 and violates AC7’s “respects current state” rule. Evidence: [operations_guidance.py](/Users/bayesian/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic/scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/operations_guidance.py:1043) only stores `pre_merge_cleared`, and [operations_guidance.py](/Users/bayesian/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic/scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/operations_guidance.py:611) treats any uncleared state as “PENDING” with an approve command; but [cli.py](/Users/bayesian/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic/scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/cli.py:326) refuses lifecycle gate approval unless the gate is currently pending. Recommendation: include pending/current gate state in `SignoffState`, emit the approve command only when `gate_pause.is_gate_currently_pending(..., "pre_merge")` or equivalent pending-stage validation passes, and otherwise return human-required advisory text with no exact command.
